            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[start] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<Edge> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a,b) -> a.w - b.w);
            pq.add(new Edge(start, 0));
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                Edge cur = pq.poll();
                int u = cur.v;
                int w = cur.w;
                if (u == end) return dist;
                if (dist[u] < w) continue;
                for (Edge e : E.get(u)) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    int w2 = w + e.w;
                    if (dist[v] > w2) {

    static class Palindrome {
        int isPalindrome(long xx) {
            List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
            long x = xx;
            while (x > 0) {
                v.add((int)(x % 10));
                x /= 10;
            }
            int n = v.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (!v.get(i).equals(v.get(n - i - 1))) return 0;
            }
            return 1;
        }
    }

    static class BigNumber {
        String add(String s1, String s2) {
            int n1 = s1.length(), n2 = s2.length();
            List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = n1 - 1, j = n2 - 1; i >= 0 && j >= 0; i--, j--) {
                int a = (s1.charAt(i) - '0') + (s2.charAt(j) - '0');
                v.add(a);
            }
            while (n1 > 0) {
                v.add(s1.charAt(--n1) - '0');
            }
            while (n2 > 0) {
                v.add(s2.charAt(--n2) - '0');
            }
            int carry = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); i++) {
                carry += v.get(i);
                if (carry >= 10) {
                    v.set(i, carry - 10);
                    carry = 1;
                } else {
                    v.set(i, carry);
                    carry = 0;
                }
            }
            if (carry > 0) v.add(carry);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = v.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) sb.append((char)(v.get(i) + '0'));
            sb.append('\n');
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }

    static class PrimeNumber {
        int N;
        int[] NP;
        List<Integer> P;
        PrimeNumber() {}
        PrimeNumber(int n) {
            N = n;
            NP = new int[N + 1];
            P = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= N; i++) {
                if (NP[i] != 0) continue;
                for (int j = i * i; j <= N; j += i) NP[j] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) if (NP[i] == 0) P.add(i);
        }
        long powmod(long a, long b) {
            if (b == 0) return 1;
            if ((b & 1) == 1) return a * powmod(a, b - 1) % MOD;
            return powmod(a * a % MOD, b / 2);
        }
        long gcd(long x, long y) {
            long z;
            while (x != 0) {
                z = y % x;
                y = x;
                x = z;
            }
            return y;
        }
        long powermod(long p, long q) {
            long g = gcd(p, q);
            p /= g; q /= g;
            return p * powmod(q, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        }
        List<Integer> factorization(int x) {
            List<Integer> ret = new ArrayList<>();
            if (x == 1) { ret.add(1); return ret; }
            ret.add(1); ret.add(x);
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) {
                    ret.add(i);
                    ret.add(x / i);
                }
            }
            if (x % (int)Math.sqrt(x) == 0) {
                int i = (int)Math.sqrt(x);
                if (i * i == x) ret.add(i);
            }
            return ret;
        }
        int factorization2(int x) {
            if (x == 1) return 1;
            int ret = 2;
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) ret += 2;
            }
            if (x % (int)Math.sqrt(x) == 0) {
                int i = (int)Math.sqrt(x);
                if (i * i == x) ret++;
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Comb {
        long[][] C;
        long[] F;
        int N;
        static final int MOD_COMB = MOD;
        Comb() {}
        Comb(int n) { init(n); }
        void init(int n) {
            N = n;
            C = new long[N + 1][];
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                C[i] = new long[i + 1];
                C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++)
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
                    C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % MOD_COMB;
            F = new long[N + 1];
            F[0] = F[1] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) F[i] = (F[i - 1] * i) % MOD_COMB;
        }
        long getC(int n, int r) { return C[n][r]; }
        long getF(int n) { return F[n]; }
        long get_comb(int n, int r) {
            if (n == r || r == 0) return 1;
            if (n <= 1000) return getC(n, r);
            if (r > n / 2) r = n - r;
            long ret = 1;
            for (int i = n; i > n - r; i--) ret *= i;
            for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) ret /= i;
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Sort {
        int[] tmp;
        int N;
        Sort(int n) {
            N = n;
            tmp = new int[n + 4];
        }
        void merge_sort(int[] x, int lo, int hi) {
            if (lo >= hi) return;
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            merge_sort(x, lo, mid);
            merge_sort(x, mid + 1, hi);
            int i = lo, j = mid + 1, k = lo;
            while (i <= mid && j <= hi) {
                if (x[i] < x[j]) tmp[k++] = x[i++];
                else tmp[k++] = x[j++];
            }
            while (i <= mid) tmp[k++] = x[i++];
            while (j <= hi) tmp[k++] = x[j++];
            for (i = lo; i <= hi; i++) x[i] = tmp[i];
        }
    }
